title: Zombie Kumar
desc: A video game developer and his companions travel to a village to attend their friend's wedding. However, their holiday turns into a nightmare due to a sudden zombie apocalypse.

title: Shravani Subramanya
desc: Subramanya, an aspiring singer, comes to Shravani's rescue when she discovers that her boyfriend Sudeep is a notorious criminal.

title: Veeran
desc: Kumaran, a teenage boy, gets struck by lightning and goes into a coma. He wakes up realising that he has superhuman abilities post the accident.

title: Jothe Jotheyali
desc: Prem and Divya, a couple, are on the verge of getting a divorce. By a twist of fate, their lives take a surprising turn when one of them gets kidnapped.

title: Luna
desc: A team of six people must employ an army of robots in order to fight and defeat the aliens invading and destroying the planet.

title: Aaradhane
desc: A religious leader performs sacred rituals and worships the idol of a Hindu deity while chanting holy hymns to seek divine blessings.

title: Navathare
desc: Partha wants to play cricket but his father strives to stop him at every step. Eventually, when he is thrown out of the cricket academy due to his father's influence, he starts using drugs.

title: Sachein
desc: Sachein saves Shalini's father from a life-changing accident. However, pride keeps them from revealing their love, as their friendship faces challenges that test their hearts and egos.
